card.essence: Lycopodium suits intellectually keen but physically weak individuals with digestive and urinary disturbances. The picture centres on flatulent distension ("full of gas"), hepatic dysfunction, lithic acid diathesis (red sand in urine), and right-sided symptoms progressing left. Patients often appear prematurely aged—thin above, dropsical below—with a characteristic 4-8 PM aggravation. Temperamentally they are anxious, lacking self-confidence, yet domineering when ill.
card.sides: Right-sided, or right to left progression
card.thermal: Chilly (craves warmth; cold extremities; lacks vital heat)

keynotes.text: Quick satiety: a few mouthfuls fill up to the throat despite good appetite
Red sand in urine (lithic acid diathesis); child cries before urinating
Right-sided complaints or symptoms travel right to left
Emaciation above (neck, face), semi-dropsical or bloated below
Excessive flatulence with loud rumbling, especially lower abdomen; bloated but not relieved by belching
One foot hot, the other cold
Prematurely aged appearance: sallow, wrinkled forehead, looks older than years

modalities_worse.text: Warmth (of room, bed) for head and spine symptoms

mentals: Lacks self-confidence; apprehensive of new tasks or breaking down under stress
Irritable, peevish, cross on waking; domineering, exacting, haughty when sick
Averse to being alone; fear of solitude; sensitive to noise
Weak memory, confused thoughts; spells or writes wrong words/syllables
Weeps easily, very sensitive; even cries when thanked
Avaricious, greedy, miserly; seeks disputes, cannot endure contradiction
Failing brain-power; cannot bear to see anything new
Little things annoy; mentally active but physically weak
physicals: Flatulent distension unrelieved by belching; loud rumbling/croaking in lower abdomen
Red sand in urine; child cries before urinating; backache better after urination
Hepatic affections; yellowish spots on skin, earthy complexion
Fan-like motion of alae nasi; snuffles; nose stopped at night, must mouth-breathe
Premature baldness and grey hair; great hair loss; dandruff
Constipation since puberty or confinement; ineffectual urging, rectum contracts/protrudes
Diphtheria: deposits spread right to left; worse cold drinks, after sleep
Deep furrows on forehead; complexion pale, dirty, sallow; looks older than age
Pneumonia (right base, lower lobe); unresolved pneumonia; deep hollow cough
Impotence in young men (onanism, excess) or old men; penis small, cold, relaxed
Dryness of vagina; burning during/after coition; discharge of blood from genitals during stool
One foot hot, other cold; feet asleep especially heels; acrid foot sweat
Right-sided hernia (especially children)
Waking at night feeling hungry
Eyes half open during sleep; day-blindness or night-blindness; sees only half an object
Dropping lower jaw in typhoid; mouth hangs open
Toothache with swelling of cheeks, better warm application
Eczema behind ears; moist oozing; otorrhoea after scarlatina
Ulceration of tonsils beginning right side
Canine hunger: the more he eats, the more he craves; headache if does not eat
clinical: Chronic digestive disorders with flatulence, hepatic dysfunction, lithic acid diathesis
Right-sided or right-to-left pneumonia (especially base/lower lobe); aids absorption/expectoration
Diphtheria spreading right to left; brownish-red fauces
Renal colic (right-sided); red sand in urine; uric acid diathesis
Impotence from sexual excess or onanism; premature emissions
Constipation (chronic, since puberty or confinement); piles
Nasal catarrh with crusts and elastic plugs; ozaena
Precocious, weakly children or pre-senile adults; extremes of life
Typhoid or scarlet fever with 4-8 PM exacerbation
Chronic skin eruptions; suppurating eruptions, boils
Gastric affections with quick satiety and fermentation
Tubercular laryngitis with ulceration; unresolved lung conditions

differentials.note: Carbo veg. flatulence upper abdomen; Lyc. lower abdomen, croaking rumbling, red sand in urine, right-sided
China bloats entire abdomen; Lyc. lower abdomen predominantly; Lyc. has 4-8 PM aggravation, right-sided tendency
Both have constipation with ineffectual urging; Nux from irregular peristalsis, portal congestion; Lyc. with flatulence, hepatic disease, 4-8 PM worse
Both antipsoric, chronic; Sulphur hotter, offensive, < warmth generally; Lyc. chilly (except head), 4-8 PM aggravation, right-sided
Both extremes of life, digestive weakness; Calc. sweaty head, sour, fat, flabby; Lyc. thin above, flatulent, red sand in urine, 4-8 PM
Both < after sleep, left-sided or right-to-left; Lach. < warm drinks, Lyc. > warm drinks; Lyc. 4-8 PM aggravation
Both lean, intellectual, hepatic affinity; Phos. haemorrhagic, desires cold drinks (Lyc. warm), no 4-8 PM aggravation

cautions: Rarely advisable to begin treatment of chronic disease with Lycopodium unless clearly indicated; better to give another antipsoric first
Deep-seated, long-acting remedy; should rarely be repeated after improvement begins
Sensitive to onions, bread, wine, spirituous liquors, tobacco (smoking/chewing)
